evaluation_target.rationale: The safety goal explicitly states that the system shall prevent unintended braking, and the hazard describes the undesired sudden stop without an obstacle in front of the vehicle.

phenomenon_of_interest.statement: Braking behavior of the ego vehicle in the stated urban-road driving situation, especially whether braking occurs when no obstacle is present in front of the vehicle.
phenomenon_of_interest.scope: Straight ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, in good weather, with no visible obstacles or vehicles in front of the ego vehicle, including any braking maneuver occurring in that situation.
phenomenon_of_interest.rationale: The hazard defines the operating situation and the hazardous event, which together delimit the relevant braking phenomenon to be characterized for evaluating the safety goal.

distinctions.dimension: Presence of an obstacle in front of the ego vehicle
distinctions.contrast_a: An obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle and braking is a response to it.
distinctions.contrast_b: No obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle and braking occurs anyway.
distinctions.rationale: Collapsing these cases would lose the information needed to judge whether braking is justified or unintended in the hazard scenario.

orrs.obligation: An Observable Representation shall preserve whether braking occurs in the presence or absence of a relevant obstacle in front of the ego vehicle, so that unintended braking can be distinguished from obstacle-justified braking.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must distinguish at least the two conditions: braking with a present obstacle in front of the ego vehicle, and braking with no obstacle in front of the ego vehicle.
